story.body: You looked up the street at the plumes and the porch. You are not in the picture.

title: Looked up the street at the plumes and the porch

participation.context: Stayed out, marked her sentence, and turned toward the walk down.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Received the student king from the steps, and did not speak.
participation.name: Sir John Spencer

participation.context: Said the sentence about the play-prince and the player.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Looked at the seat on the hired horse, and said he would walk down.
participation.name: Richard Burbage

relations.note: her sentence, at the mouth of the close

relations.quote: Sir John has not looked this way.

story.body: You stood with Mistress Ansell and Burbage among the backs. She said the City in one sentence. You and Burbage laughed over the Night of Errors. He looked at the hired horse. Sir John did not speak. You did not go in.

relations.note: her sentence, at the mouth of the close

relations.quote: Sir John has not looked this way.

title: Stayed at the mouth of the close

description: Four lines, and no new count

participation.context: Wrote the four lines and lifted the pen.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You wrote the four lines you had already paid, and you did not add a total or a new count of the coffer.

title: Lined four payments and stopped
